tokens.text: 1) "If it's positive, if they think I'm going to live a long while, I could plan accordingly. It would help you get your house in order, so to speak, if it's negative, if I only have a little time left to live."
2) "Because I have a right to know what he's thinking about, I wouldn't go to a doctor who wouldn't talk to me or communicate freely."
3) "I want to know as much as I can about myself. I'm not afraid to be told I may die or when."
1) "It might discombobulate me and interfere with my will to live."
2) "What for? What will be accomplished by that conversation, as long as I'm healthy? If I were seriously ill, I'd want to make provisions while I could, for my family."
3) "It would color all of your decisions and I don't think you should be making them on a guesstimate!"
